policy_analysis.coast: Observed coast deceleration can reduce speed but may roll backward; no stable-stop guarantee. Start coast only with measured remaining-distance envelope plus age margin, keep emergency override.
policy_analysis.normal_brake: At low speed even tiny brake produces immediate impulse; ideal jerk bound is not a calibrated achievable command. No globally certified comfortable interval.
policy_analysis.hold: Enter only at measured near-zero window (~0.02 m/s in historical cases), and verify consecutive speed/position stability; local window does not certify approach reachability.
policy_analysis.emergency: Preserved full brake independent of comfort; report separately.

conclusion: Finite sampled feasible points only. No full comfortable speed-to-prescribed-distance trajectory established; no proof that all possible controls are infeasible.
